verdict.rationale: Ollama documents official Python and JavaScript/TypeScript libraries for using it from applications. These sit on top of a REST API, plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints that let existing client SDKs point at Ollama. The SDK evidence, however, is only one-line doc mentions. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or docs evidence, official SDKs beyond Python and JS/TS, a published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
